en: A black and white photograph showing a large, well-preserved castle perched dramatically on a rocky promontory above a river, surrounded by dense forest. The castle has several pointed towers and tall roofs, characteristic of Central European architecture. In the background, there is a large building complex that resembles a historical factory or institutional facility, with a tall smokestack. More wooded hills and the outline of a church spire can be seen further back. There is no visible text on the image.
